lines: Hi! I'm Prue! I'm Nina's sister! I'm seven and three quarters! Do you like plushies? I have nine. Ten if you count the sock.
Swings! Push me! Higher! HIGHER! ...Okay that's high enough.
This is my room. It's lilac. Lilac is purple but nicer.

rotate: I saw a little green alien in the pumpkin patch! Nina says it was a squash. Squashes don't wave!
Bruno lets me ride his skateboard if I sit down on it. It's still skating!
Mr. Palmer gave me a sweet. It was green. It fizzed. I don't know where he got it.
